body:
### Unfunded CTA shown while balance loads **Medium Severity** `hasNoAvailableBalance` no longer waits for the live account to finish loading, and `isSubmitDisabled` dropped the `isLoadingAccount` guard. `getTradeableBalance` returns `0` when `account` is null, so a funded wallet looks unfunded until the stream arrives. The primary button becomes an enabled Add funds to trade control and can open a deposit instead of waiting for the real balance.
Additional Locations (2) - [`ui/pages/perps/perps-order-entry-page.tsx#L363-L364`](https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-extension/blob/c45015c2ea708fc99b82fe14d60dcec1b4f7d7c0/ui/pages/perps/perps-order-entry-page.tsx#L363-L364) - [`ui/pages/perps/perps-order-entry-page.tsx#L1079-L1094`](https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-extension/blob/c45015c2ea708fc99b82fe14d60dcec1b4f7d7c0/ui/pages/perps/perps-order-entry-page.tsx#L1079-L1094)

body:
### Row CTA ignores account loading **Medium Severity** The available-to-trade row now shows a labeled `Add funds` control whenever `availableBalance` is below `PERPS_UNFUNDED_BALANCE_THRESHOLD_USDC`. While the account stream is still loading, `getTradeableBalance` falls back to `0`, so funded users can briefly (or longer) see the unfunded row CTA even though the footer correctly waits on `isLoadingAccount` and does not switch to `Add funds to trade`. Clicking that row control can open deposit during hydration and is tracked as a funded add-funds click because `hasNoAvailableBalance` is still false.
Additional Locations (1) - [`ui/pages/perps/perps-order-entry-page.tsx#L881-L887`](https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-extension/blob/002b882c412dba3dc489e0752d9060612c4dbdd2/ui/pages/perps/perps-order-entry-page.tsx#L881-L887)
